content.thinking:
I'm weighing whether section 3.4 should request documents when an ID check result is still unknown, or classify the person as incomplete. One option keeps the rule as it is and asks for documents right away. The other limits the rule to cases where the check has actually failed, but then an unknown value still falls through and ends up marked incomplete.

I'm checking that a third option isn't needed, since the two I have already cover it. The edit would scope the rule to people whose id_verified fact is "no", and I'm working out how the wording for the owner should read, with "Yes, ask for documents now" kept and "No, incomplete until check returns" as the alternative.

parsed.question: When the identity check on an identified individual has not come back yet, so it is not known whether the person is verified, should 3.4 ask the customer for documents now, or should the case go back as incomplete under 2.2 until the check comes back?

options.says: 3.4 asks for documents for any identified individual not yet shown to be verified, including one whose check hasn't come back, so these cases come out as request documents rather than incomplete.

options.option: No, incomplete until the check returns
options.says: 3.4 asks for documents only when an identity check found the person unverified; while a check hasn't come back, the case is incomplete under 2.2.

rule.text: Verify the identity of every identified individual. If any is unverified, request documents.
